purpose: Outlook-first fulfilment paths backed by a OneDrive/SharePoint local mirror.

evidex.route: Outlook lead/reply -> OneDrive upload folder -> local mirror -> Evidex watcher -> Outlook delivery
evidex.job_ready_rule: Process when intake.yaml exists and uploads/ contains at least one source file.

homs.route: Outlook lead/reply -> OneDrive upload folder -> local mirror -> HOMS batch runner -> educator review pack -> Outlook delivery
homs.job_ready_rule: Process only fake, redacted, or non-sensitive batches with a rubric/memo and explicit educator-review boundary.

sync_note: On Windows, point OneDrive sync at the matching EVIDEX/HOMS folder tree. On Linux, mount/sync with rclone or another OneDrive client, then set the watcher root to the local_root.
